hints.title: Low Score Elimination
hints.text: Because the array length is at least 3, modifying any one element to equal an existing element reduces the low score to 0.

hints.title: High Score Range Reduction
hints.text: The problem simplifies to minimizing the difference between the maximum and minimum elements after modifying at most two values.

hints.title: Boundary Removal Candidates
hints.text: In a sorted array, the two modified elements must target extremes: both smallest, both largest, or one of each.

hints.title: Sorted Extreme Removal Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n); checking 3 options takes O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Combinations of pairs to modify requires iterating over all pairs and checking ranges.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Deduces that low score can always be forced to 0, leaving range minimization on extremes.
